claim: Postgres real cross-architecture E2E gate required
scope: No-dump machinen snapshot/restore for real PostgreSQL across amd64<->arm64 requires retained source and target PostgreSQL E2E artifacts before any public claim.
promotionEffect: Blocks public Postgres product and broad-service claims until real PostgreSQL E2E validation exists in both architecture directions.

proofs.proves: Start real PostgreSQL on amd64, load schema/data/workload, capture through product snapshot command without user-supplied dump, restore on arm64 target-native PostgreSQL, and pass verifier/app workload.
proofs.claimUse: required before any amd64->arm64 public Postgres claim
proofs.next: Run and retain the amd64->arm64 source transcript, target transcript, bundle manifest, restore summary, verifier outputs, and workload results.

proofs.proves: Repeat the real PostgreSQL no-dump product snapshot/restore path from arm64 to amd64 with target-native PostgreSQL and retained verifier/app workload outputs.
proofs.claimUse: required before bidirectional public Postgres claim
proofs.next: Run and retain the arm64->amd64 source transcript, target transcript, bundle manifest, restore summary, verifier outputs, and workload results.

proofs.proves: The user-facing product command captures PostgreSQL without requiring the user to provide a prebuilt dump; any logical dump is internally produced and retained as implementation evidence.
proofs.claimUse: required to claim machinen snapshot/restore rather than dump-import fixture support
proofs.next: Add product command proof that creates internal dump/provenance and refuses unsafe source state.

proofs.proves: Active sessions/transactions, dirty WAL, physical data-dir copy, replication/failover state, source-ISA emulation, sidecars, hooks, and metadata-only success are refused in the real E2E harness.
proofs.claimUse: required to bound any future claim
proofs.next: Run refusal cases in the same E2E harness and retain refusal artifacts.
